behavior_constraints: promote copies deployment state from source env to target env; both envs must exist in manifest or error
promote processes services in dependency order
promote prints `PROMOTE <service> -> <target>: SKIP (same version)` when target already has exact same version
promote prints `PROMOTE <service> -> <target> OK` when copying deployment to target
services not deployed in source are silently skipped during promote
promote does not require tests; reuses already-deployed artifacts
promote --service NAME promotes only that service plus transitive dependencies
promote --dry-run prints `DRY-RUN promote from <source> to <target>:` header then `  Would promote <service>` for each service that would actually change (excluding skips)
promote summary line after processing (non-dry-run): `Promoted N, skipped M`
diff compares deployment states of two envs; both must exist in manifest or error
entities.summary: Add promote, diff, and history commands plus a per-environment append-only event log, and modify deploy/rollback to record events.

instruction_head:
Extend the pipeline orchestrator with three new commands that build on the existing deployment infrastructure: `promote`, `diff`, and `history`. Additionally, all deployment-related commands must now record events into a per-environment event log so that history tracking works.

**`pipeline.sh promote <source-env> <target-env> [--service NAME] [--dry-run]`** — Copy deployment state from a source environment to a target environment. Both environments must exist in the manifest. Services are promo
